critical_audit: The first unmatched page-side PCA was strongly contaminated by page length: original PC1 correlated r=-0.886 with n_tokens. That PC1 had been interpreted as a section axis. Phase56C therefore replaces that interpretation with matched-token analyses.

page_matched40.sampling: 30 random contiguous 40-token body windows per page-side; feature values averaged within page-side
page_matched40.interpretation: After equalizing sample size, there is no single dominant section axis. The largest axis is a near-family/local-continuity axis, while metadata effects are distributed over several dimensions.

paragraph_matched20.sampling: 20 random contiguous 20-token body windows per paragraph; feature values averaged
paragraph_matched20.interpretation: The strongest two matched latent directions recur at page-side and paragraph scales; PC1 and PC2 loadings are qualitatively very similar. Higher axes are less stable individually but the 5-dimensional subspaces overlap strongly on most directions.

paragraph_locality_in_5d.interpretation: Paragraph states are more similar within the same page-side than within the same broad section+hand elsewhere, indicating a page-local state component below section labels.

physical_distance_by_matched_page_axis.interpretation: The physical-distance gradient is strongest on matched PC1, the near-family/local-continuity axis. Physical locality therefore appears to involve which token-family topology is locally active, not only page length or section identity.

linear_vs_nonlinear_heldout_reconstructi.cv: 5-fold GroupKFold by physical leaf on matched40 page fingerprints; train-fold standardization
linear_vs_nonlinear_heldout_reconstructi.kernel_gamma_sensitivity: At gamma=0.02, KPCA approaches but remains worse than PCA: k3 0.4030 vs PCA 0.3895; k5 0.2640 vs 0.2504. Larger gamma values are worse.
linear_vs_nonlinear_heldout_reconstructi.interpretation: There is no current evidence that a nonlinear manifold compresses the audited matched page-side fingerprint better than a linear subspace.

decision: H56-1 receives qualified support: structural variation is moderately low-dimensional rather than 1-2 dimensional. Roughly 3 dimensions capture 64% and 5 capture 79% of matched page variance; 5-dimensional held-out linear reconstruction is substantially better than lower dimensions. The earlier claim that PC1 is a dominant section axis is withdrawn as a sample-size artifact. The stable cross-scale signal is instead a near-family/local-continuity axis plus several morphology/entropy/kt axes. Proceed to line/paragraph transition mapping and then residualization using matched or explicitly sample-size-corrected features.
